name: paulian-sync-relay
description: Paulian Calendar sync relay for Cloudflare Workers + Durable Objects (free plan). Deploy your own: end-to-end encrypted, no account, no secrets.

RETENTION_DAYS_V2.description: Days without any sync activity after which a group's encrypted data is deleted from **your** relay. Default `90`.

V1_MODE.description: Leave as `off`. Old sync protocol, not needed for a new relay.

RETENTION_DAYS.description: Only used by the old protocol. Leave as is.

V1_READONLY_UNTIL.description: Only used by the old protocol. Leave as is.
